acceptanceCriteria: A post-run authority call that expires its deadline yields a documented class distinct from ErrAuthorityDrift, with the GLTP spec amended under owner acceptance.
A test using provider.WithPostAuthorityBound(1ns) asserts the new class; a test with real drift still asserts ErrAuthorityDrift.
body: Found in the V1-1420 lane (PR #928, BASE 6457b86bc, darwin go1.27.2). provider.Execute makes three post-run authority calls (revalidate, observe, release), each with a fresh 15 s postAuthorityTimeout; a deadline expiry is reported as ErrAuthorityDrift "post-run revalidation" although no authority changed. Expected: a distinct timeout/unavailable class. Actual: drift is claimed. Repro: BASE cmd/corvint-go-test-provider NonASCII/NormalCompletion at load 40-65. A new class changes a documented refusal (GLTP-V0-027/041): owner decision.
title: liveverify provider reports post-run authority deadline expiry as ErrAuthorityDrift (execution authority changed)
